introduced.event_name: NCC June 1982 — colour graphics and mouse interaction

implementation_design.status: Accepted implementation design; command timing and analog settling require measurement.

memory.count_register: 10-bit unsigned count, legal range 0..512; no in-band terminator consumes an entry.
memory.encoding: Byte 0: unsigned scanline delta 0..255. Byte 1: bits 7..4 palette register 0..15, bits 3..0 red. Byte 2: bits 7..4 green, bits 3..0 blue. Each RGB component is 4 bits.

implementation_design.coordinates: Offsets count physical active output scanlines, independent of logical mode scaling. Start accumulator at 0 each frame; add delta before applying entry. Delta 0 permits multiple writes before the same line, including line 0. Reject overflow, out-of-frame targets and excess writes per line; never wrap. Bridge gaps above 255 with an explicitly redundant write preserving the current register value.
implementation_design.execution: Prefetch records into dedicated sequencer registers/FIFO, outside the 1536-byte allocation. Execute during blanking before the target active scanline; reset pointer/counter at frame start. Restore a saved 16-register base palette every vertical blank before replay. Line-0 entries follow base restoration.
implementation_design.updates: Single list buffer. CPU writes only with sequencer disabled or after completion before the next frame; arm validated count/base palette at vertical blank. No implicit full-list double buffer; late/incomplete updates remain disabled.
implementation_design.wire: Opt-in capability extension over the existing Control pair, host-to-monitor during the reserved blanking window, clocked from pixel Clock. No simultaneous capability readback. Proposed fixed 32-bit write: 4-bit opcode, 4-bit register, 12-bit RGB, 4 reserved zero bits, CRC-8 (poly 0x07, init 0, no reflection/xorout), MSB first. Reset command framing at blank start; specify setup/hold, turnaround and CRC failure behavior before release.
implementation_design.budget: 640x400 raster has 160 blank clocks = about 7.44 us. Target maximum four 32-bit commands per blank (128 clocks, about 5.95 us), leaving 32 clocks for guards/commit/settling. This is a qualification target, not an unconditional measured guarantee. Advertise the validated per-raster limit; 512 total entries does not allow 512 writes on one scanline.
implementation_design.commit: Monitor validates complete commands into staging registers and commits together before active pixels. Reject invalid/late batches, retain previous palette and latch diagnostic status; never update midway through an active line.
implementation_design.scope: For raster effects on Color Pro use the 640x400 physical raster, including line-doubled 640x200. Other raster/monitor combinations require their own advertised timing budget. Old monitors receive only supported vertical-retrace commands.
implementation_design.colour_semantics: Palette is global to text, bitmap and sprites at each scanline. 2 bpp still selects only four background indices on a line; 4 bpp selects sixteen. More colours across different lines do not imply a larger per-pixel index or arbitrary 4096-colour bitmap.
validation: Worst-case four-command blanking with DAC settling
All 512 records, same-line writes, delta 255 and frame bounds
DRAM refresh and host/DMA contention during prefetch
CRC errors, late packets and safe palette retention
Base palette restore and list restart without frame-to-frame drift
